newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney trims Delta EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney trims Delta EPS view.

text.p: Smith Barney said it trimmed its earnings estimate for Delta Air Lines Inc to $4.30 a share from $4.65 a share for the fiscal fourth quarter ending in June.
-- said trimmed the full year earnings estimate to $11.30 a share from $11.65 a share.

-- On Monday, Delta said its June quarter unit revenue performance will be weaker than originally expected. But the airline said it still expects to meet or exceed industry year-over-year unit revenue growth in the June quarter.
